sources.name: Anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5 launch page
sources.note: Vendor run: max effort, adaptive thinking, production safeguards. Anthropic reports a +/-2.6 point standard error on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and notes that the public leaderboard's Claude Code harness scores Opus 5 at 51.8% where its own setup reproduces 52.3%.

sources.name: LLM Stats: SWE-Bench Pro leaderboard
sources.note: 62 models, 0 independently verified, 62 self-reported. Scale's standardized public set tops out near 61.5%, roughly 28 points below the self-reported top row.
